bio.text: Scot Matayoshi represents District 49 in the Hawaii House of Representatives and took office on November 6, 2018; he is running for re-election in 2026.
He earned a bachelor's degree in government from Claremont McKenna College in 2006, and a J.D. and an M.Ed. from the University of Hawaii at Manoa.
His professional experience includes working as an associate at McCorriston Miller Mukai Mackinnon and at Shlack Ito, LLC.
